line_range_convention: inclusive, one-indexed, original bytes including line endings

claims.title: Literal standard data give the exact coarse scale and geometric prefix bounds
claims.statement: For compatible actual segment digits and A0(1-epsilon)<=A<=A0, all A,Ai,Ci>=k^3; p>=k^2, k>=10, 4lambda<=k; both consecutive coarse degree ratios are at least p^2/2 and preceding sums are <=4/p^2 times the current degree. The exact early/late alternative is SW10.

claims.title: Actual weighted pairs, their sparse tail shape and coordinate bounds
claims.statement: The exact total pair weight is dimMM, and horizontal-strip propagation proves all PairFactsAt inequalities, including the signed lower-tail bound n_i<=Ci(1+4/p^2).

claims.title: An explicit finite encoding bounds the actual number of pairs
claims.statement: The actual pair set has cardinality at most (8a)^(4(N1+1)^2), by encoding only its first s+1 and last s coordinates at each state.

claims.title: The regularized quadratic identity proves the complete bad-pair bracket
claims.statement: Every non-kept pair has a product bracket theta with theta^(r-1)<=exp(2-lambda/5). Either failed literal kept inequality contributes exp(-lambda/(4k)); zero factors require no division.

claims.title: Weighted bad mass is at most exp(-lambda/8) with the exact source threshold
claims.statement: A signed-strip path bounds wdim by a product of symmetric-power dimensions. Combined with RD4 and the explicit pair count, this proves the exact TailAt lower mass (1-exp(-lambda/8))*dimMM. The human bound before the final polynomial envelope is stronger than the source statement.

claims.title: The actual early, late and terminal kept-block inequalities
claims.statement: PairUAt, PairSAt and PairXAt hold with the exact source bounds, including early sg<=2lambda*A0/k and the terminal negative-mass correction.

claims.title: The literal kept-block map preserves weights, levels and every prefix cutoff
claims.statement: pairMap constructs actual kept blocks with the original digits, legal levels, and the exact margin cutoffs; cap_l=M+c_l. It is injective because the degree sums recover omitted first coordinates, and gives MatchAt by a finite weighted sum. Target finiteness is proved directly, independently of the source's use of MatchUp.

claims.title: The terminal hockey-stick loss and the rounded initial-degree loss
claims.statement: The terminal sum is at least (1-exp(-lambda/3))*binom(B+r,r), and binom(A0-M+r,r)>=(1-rM/A0)binom(A0+r,r), including a negative final factor.

claims.title: The exact lower rank on each compatible digit class
claims.statement: For h>=0 and ceil(h)<=A0*N1*lambda/k, rankOnDigits>=lowFac*mmB with lowFac=(1-exp(-lambda/8))(1-exp(-lambda/3))(1-r*ceil(h)/A0). This is the actual LowAt/RestLow with all original ring and digit conventions.

claims.title: The two-sided half-density window with its exact ceiling
claims.statement: For 0<=h<=b'/(kQY), the lower factor is at least 29/45>1/2, giving mmB/2<=rankOnDigits<=mmB. This is the pointwise content of RootMultiplicityTwoBeyond and its uniform form follows with NP2.

claims.title: A finite telescoping proof strengthens the actual harmonic diagonal density
claims.statement: For P(t)=binom(t+r,r), H=P(alpha)P(beta)-P(alpha-1)P(beta-1), the actual P1 term is >=R_j-R_(j+1). Consequently its finite sum is >=1-exp(-lambda'/3) under the literal window bound, removing the source's extra initial-degree loss and infinite-series detour.

claims.title: All harmonic density fields hold uniformly at max(TLP,400)
claims.statement: Under literal Dat.Hyp and K.Pos, C_H>=max(TLP,400) supplies DensityNumericalFacts with d=1-exp(-lambda'/3), exact enlarged-cardinality factor2, and the original coordinate windows. The auxiliary threshold is1.

claims.title: The actual column-box boundary loss and conductor correction
claims.statement: Under literal final Hyp with C_H>=TLP, the unshifted windows are positive, wa,wb>=2YNc, the removed product-box fraction is <=1/Y, and 12Nkc/b'<=1/Y. These are all fields of ColumnSpanNumericalFacts, with auxiliary threshold1.

claims.title: Exact segment marginalization proves the enlarged-window MeanX
claims.statement: For CA>=max{56,2(31e^3+5)e^3,1} and Cs>=Ckap(Cm+4CE1+CE2+15), the actual segment means and kapPI bound imply mean kx<=(CA+Cs)NN1/Y. Each segment restriction fiber has exactly waP^(N-s_j-1) elements; no independence is assumed.

claims.title: The actual final exceptional mean with Cmean=6(CA+Cs)+8
claims.statement: The literal kText on the signed final weight box has mean at most [6(CA+Cs)+8]NN1/Y. The proof tracks subtraction on the inside box, the boundary fraction, bijective positive shift and exact conductor correction.

derived_simplifications: The lower source support is finite directly from kept order bounds; MatchUp is not needed merely to justify summation.
The single bad-pair weight bound is stronger than its source polynomial envelope; C0>=880 is retained.
P1>=Rj-R(j+1) proves the harmonic density by finite telescoping and removes the initial-degree loss in the archival infinite-series route.
Cubing gives N exp(-lambda'/3)<=1/3; rational Bernoulli bounds prove the same factor2 enlarged-window inequality at the unchanged threshold400.
outside_scope: Digit-class summation and aggregate HH rank are RU9–RU11, not duplicated here.
Actual harmonic maps/dimensions and KeyIneq/Avg are HM1/HM6/HM7, with exact dependencies preserved.
Uniform parameter supply and kapPI are NP2–NP9; pointwise lower-rank proofs do not silently identify Std with bare HIext.
General cloud transfer, coefficient-ring transport and global arithmetic/spectral/cohomological RH/GRH branches are separate.
scope_note: Complete human proofs of the named local count, density-record and mean interfaces under their literal hypotheses and listed completed dependencies. Source-byte validation is not a Lean build or kernel replay.
